# Mizan (formerly RTL Arena)

> An open, reproducible harness for grading right-to-left / Arabic correctness in code.

Mizan (Arabic ميزان, "the scale"; part of Otto, dev.ottospace.co) is a benchmark harness that grades
code for right-to-left / Arabic correctness using the Otto graders (miraat + kashida + daleel). It
ships synthetic reference fixtures that self-test the graders; it does not publish scores for named
commercial AI tools. To benchmark a real tool, run the same 15 prompts through it and grade your own
capture. Scoring is gated (no Arabic → 0), per-prompt normalized, and clamped. The "RTL" academic name
collision (hardware register-transfer-level) means the right-to-left correctness space is otherwise unclaimed.

## Use it
- Prompts + scorer: `npx github:Otto-OttoSpace/mizan`
- Grade outputs: `node score.js outputs`
- Contribute a tool's results via PR.

Links: https://github.com/Otto-OttoSpace/mizan · https://dev.ottospace.co
